1. The chief of pelico of Turtle Islands shall, in addition
to his duties as such and until a regular deputy provincial
and municipal district treasurer is appointed under existing
laws, perform the duties and functions of deputy provincial
and municipal district treasurer, subject to the supervision
of the provincial treasurer of Sulu and to the same rules
and regulations governing the position, duties and func-
tions of municipal district treasurer.
5. There shall be assigned on regular patrol duty in and
around the Turtle Islands a detachment of Constabulary
soldiers under the command of a commissioned officer, who
shall also act as deputy of the Commissioner of Immigra-
6. The proper authorities shall immediately provide such
measures as are necessary towards the immediate conser-
vation, management, or disposition of the turtle products

The provisions of Executive Order No. 95, dated Octber
13, 1947, inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of April, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Philipines, the second.
I PIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
